## POM Extensions Added (COD-8)

All additions are appended to the existing `pages/release_dashboard_page.py` without modifying existing methods.

| New Selector / Method              | Purpose                                                         | Used by TC             |
|------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------|
| `SEARCH_FILTER`                    | Locates `#search-filter` input                                  | TC-021                 |
| `PRODUCT_FILTER`                   | Locates `#product-filter` select                                | TC-017                 |
| `EMPTY_STATE`                      | Locates `.empty-state` paragraph                                | TC-014, TC-023         |
| `click_delete_button_on_first_card()` | Clicks Delete on first card without auto-accepting dialog    | TC-002..TC-014, TC-021..TC-023 |
| `click_delete_button_by_title()`   | Clicks Delete on a named card without auto-accepting            | TC-006..TC-008, TC-016..TC-022 |
| `click_delete_last_card_by_title()` | Clicks Delete on the last card matching a title               | TC-016                 |
| `accept_dialog()`                  | Accepts the browser confirm dialog                              | Multiple               |
| `dismiss_dialog()`                 | Dismisses (cancels) the browser confirm dialog                  | TC-002, TC-009..TC-011 |
| `is_dialog_present()`              | Returns True if an alert is currently open                      | TC-002                 |
| `is_empty_state_visible()`         | Returns True if `.empty-state` element is displayed             | TC-014, TC-023         |
| `set_product_filter(value)`        | Selects an option in the product filter drop-down               | TC-017                 |
| `get_product_filter_value()`       | Returns the currently selected product filter value             | TC-017                 |
| `set_search_filter(text)`          | Types text into the search filter input                         | TC-021                 |
| `get_edit_form_title_value()`      | Returns the title input field's current value                   | TC-008, TC-020         |
| `is_form_in_default_state()`       | Returns True if submit button reads "Add Release Note"          | TC-008                 |
| `click_edit_card_by_title(title)`  | Clicks Edit on the card matching a given title                  | TC-020                 |
